text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running with everything she had, Inari One 
won the Takarazuka Kinen, earning praise 
from Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Inari One, inspired by Tamamo 
Cross's dignified attitude and 
forward-looking spirit, vowed that she 
would definitely deliver results in this 
race next year.
